items.title: Solana Just Got Faster—Is It Bullish for SOL?
items.summary: Solana has activated the first reduction in its block timing since launch, speeding up transactions on the network.

items.title: Solana cuts blockchain slot time to 350 milliseconds
items.summary: Solana reduced its slot time for the first time since genesis as it works toward a 200-millisecond target aimed at reducing network latency.

items.title: Bitcoin holds $64,000 and solana leads gains amid 7% Korean chip stock slide
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $64,000 and every major except BNB gained, while Korean semiconductor stocks fell more than 7% and Fed minutes are due at 2 p.m. ET.
